county.name: Paul Simba Arati
county.note: Confirmed by two sources: the Kisii County Government site reports him sworn in as Governor (kisii.go.ke, "H.E Hon. Paul Simba Arati Sworn In as Governor"), and Capital FM reports his swearing-in. Declared with 270,928 votes (Mzalendo; Gazette 9949 was not found in search and is not relied on). No removal found as of the search date.

county.name: Elijah Obebo
county.since: Jul 2024 (sworn in after a High Court order)
county.note: Robert Monda, elected Deputy Governor with Governor Arati in 2022, was impeached by the County Assembly; the Senate upheld the impeachment in March 2024. The Governor nominated Elijah Obebo, then chair of the County Public Service Board, and the Assembly approved him. On 4 July 2024 the High Court at Kisii directed the IEBC to gazette him or have him sworn in; he was sworn in at Gusii Stadium in July 2024. Monda went to court against his removal; conservatory orders were refused in 2024 and no final outcome was found as of Nov 2026.

county.name: Philip Nyanumba
county.since: Elected after the 2022 election (date not confirmed); presiding Mar 2026
county.note: Elected the Assembly's third Speaker with 47 votes to 21, replacing David Kombo (Mount Kenya Times, undated). The county website's Speaker page still names an earlier Speaker.

mcaSourceName: IEBC Gazette Notice No. 9956 (2022 baseline; no later changes found)
mcaGazetteNote: Built 27 Nov 2026. All 45 MCAs from IEBC Gazette Notice No. 9956 (Vol. CXXIV, No. 170, 24 Aug 2022), file sha256 eafe12d9…23e2a; every name, party and vote count was matched by script to its ward line in the PDF text. Names are written other names, then surname, as in the Nyamira file; for 11 wards (Kiamokama, Kiogoro and all of Kitutu Chache North and South) the gazette columns may hold the names in a different order, noted on each. The IEBC by-election gazette of 1 Dec 2025 lists no Kisii ward, and searches did not find any Kisii MCA death, nullification or by-election since Aug 2022 (not exhaustive). Party names are those printed in 2022; members may have changed party since. Keep mcaGazetteChecked false until the flagged names are checked against the County Assembly member list.

kiamokama.note: Not published: the 2022 MCA (Mainya Matara Malack, ODM, 2,886 votes, per gazette 9956) was followed by a by-election after the seat fell vacant on the death of the previous MCA. Reports name the by-election winner as Malachi Matara (ODM). The date and the gazetted result are not yet confirmed, so the current holder is not set.

kiogoro.name: Obare Mochache Walter
kiogoro.note: Confirmed by two sources. Gazette 9956: surname Walter, other names Obare Mochache, Wiper, 3,766 votes (column order fixed by the gazette schedule, columns 7 and 8). Mzalendo lists the same person as Walter Obare Mochache, Wiper, 3,766 votes.

monyerero.note: Not published: gazette 9956 gives surname Gichana and other names Otachi Peter (ODM, 4,135 votes). A news-based list gives Peter Gichana, which omits the first name. Not set until a second full-name source is found.

sensi.note: Not published: gazette 9956 names Saisi Nyagaka Onchonga (PDP, 1,815 votes), but a Nation report lists Sensi among the ODM wins. The sources conflict on the party and name order is also disputed; neither the name nor the party is set until the County Assembly list or the Kenya Gazette declaration is checked.
